title: Bitwarden Secrets Manager: `bitwardenServerSDKURL` is required

detection.reason: a missing key is not a projected value; the store projection names the keys present

remediation: Set `spec.provider.bitwardensecretsmanager.bitwardenServerSDKURL` (the bitwarden-sdk-server Service URL) on each store named; validation now fails without it (an empty URL never worked; #5679 only adds the check).
verifyCommand: kubectl get secretstores.external-secrets.io,clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.provider | has("bitwardensecretsmanager")) | select((.spec.provider.bitwardensecretsmanager.bitwardenServerSDKURL // "") == "") | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row is a Bitwarden store missing the SDK URL

title: Templates: ESO's sprig fork replaced by upstream sprig; `camelcase` now emits PascalCase
remediation: For installs on 0.10.0–1.1.0 (the fork's lifetime): template functions now come from upstream Masterminds/sprig v3.3.0, and `camelcase` changes output. The fork produced lowerCamel (`foo_bar` → `fooBar`), upstream produces PascalCase (`FooBar`), so templates of the ExternalSecrets named that build keys with it write different keys. Use `camelcase | untitle` to keep the old form.
verifyCommand: kubectl get externalsecrets.external-secrets.io,clusterexternalsecrets.external-secrets.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | . as $o | (.spec.target.template // .spec.externalSecretSpec.target.template // {}) | tostring | select(test("camelcase")) | $o | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row's template calls camelcase

title: Helm chart: default image registry moved back to ghcr.io

detection.reason: Helm values and registry allow-lists are not collected; the running image is

remediation: If image pulls are restricted to `oci.external-secrets.io` (egress, admission allow-list, mirror), allow `ghcr.io` or pin the three `*.image.repository` values before upgrading; the chart default changed back.
verifyCommand: kubectl get deploy -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(any(.spec.template.spec.containers[]; .image | test("(^|/)(external-secrets/external-secrets|bitnami/external-secrets)([:@]|$)"))) | "\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name) \([.spec.template.spec.containers[].image] | join(","))"'  # each row is an ESO workload and the registry it pulls from today
coversNotes: chart value certController.image.repository default changed oci.external-secrets.io/ -> ghcr.io/external-secrets
chart value image.repository default changed oci.external-secrets.io/ -> ghcr.io/external-secrets
chart value webhook.image.repository default changed oci.external-secrets.io/ -> ghcr.io/external-secrets
